title: Hives, Trees, and the Turning Year

sets.relationshipLabel: a category of plant and a particular kind of it
sets.explanation: A flower and a tree are each broad categories, and clover and willow are specific members of those categories.

sets.relationshipLabel: a thing worked in beekeeping and the tool built to work it
sets.explanation: A comb is worked by an extractor and a hive is worked by a smoker — each tool exists specifically to act on that object.

sets.relationshipLabel: a bee and the one thing it can never have
sets.explanation: A drone bee has no stinger and a queen bee has no pollen basket — each lacks the one feature that defines a different caste's role.

sets.relationshipLabel: two moments facing each other across a span
sets.explanation: Dawn and dusk bookend a day, while spring and autumn bookend a year — each pair marks true opposite poles of a natural cycle.

glossary.definition: a small hollow spot fringed with hairs on a bee's hind leg, used to carry things back to the nest

definitions.definition: the colorful blooming part of a plant, often sweet-smelling and full of nectar
a small low-growing plant with three-part leaves, loved by bees and lucky finders alike
a tall woody plant with a trunk, branches, and leaves that can live for many years
a graceful tree with long drooping branches, often found near water
the waxy, six-sided structure bees build to store honey and raise young
a spinning machine that pulls honey out of the wax without destroying it
the home where a colony of bees lives, builds comb, and raises its young
a small device that puffs out calming smoke to keep bees settled while beekeepers work
a male bee whose main job is to mate with a queen, not to gather food or defend the hive
the sharp defensive part some bees use to protect themselves and their hive
the single bee in a colony whose job is to lay all the eggs
a small hollow spot fringed with hairs on a bee's hind leg, used to carry things back to the nest
the early moment when the sky lightens and the sun first rises
the soft dim time just after sunset, before full dark sets in
the season when the world wakes up, with new growth and warming days
the season when leaves turn color and fall as the air cools
